arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Harris argued claimants do not need to challenge ALJ appointments before the agency.
Mr. Raynor argued claimants forfeit issues not raised during agency proceedings.
Justice Alito asked how the government accounts for wasted time and money.
Justice Alito suggested ALJs should reconsider cases under their new appointment status.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether Social Security claimants must challenge ALJ appointment flaws before the agency. the sides that brought the case argue they can raise this issue in district court. The government argues claimants must raise it during agency proceedings.
